spec.name: Halloween Candy Sorting Workbench
spec.description: Original Orange SMP Halloween workbench with a deep-purple cabinet, three separate open baskets with orange, green and purple rims, and a wooden sorting conveyor across the back. Axis-aligned geometry fits within 32 × 16 × 32 model units. Basket interiors and conveyor gaps remain open. No lettering, stands or animations.

prompt: Purple witch workbench with three clearly separate open baskets arranged left to right, orange green purple basket rims, a wooden conveyor surface at the back. Fits x,z 0..32 y0..16. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
